name: media
description: Audio, video extras and images: transcribe and summarise recordings, normalise loudness, remove noise, cut silences, convert formats, text to speech; merge, reverse, burn and translate subtitles, background music with ducking, stabilise, GIF, watermark, screen and webcam recording; resize (batch), rotate/flip/B&W/blur/sharpen, strip metadata, memes, read text in images.
route: work on an audio file, video file or image the owner names by path: transcribe, clean up, convert, subtitles, music, stabilise, gif, watermark, resize, meme, OCR; record the screen
